messages:
alex_tsai: Quick sync: saw another latency spike when affinity leases evict + we try to rebind creds across Hosted/Dedicated/Private. Who owns rebind? control-plane or runtime?

maggie_h: We don't have a single contract. Hosted -> control-plane; Private -> runtime (customer KMS). That mismatch leads to races.

jordan: Proposal: define a tiny on_eviction interface. Return a small enum/hint and a boolean so consumers can decide fast. Something like: on_eviction(evict_meta) -> (handback_required, handback_hint).

alex_tsai: If we have that, the probe can skip full manifest fetch and make a quick decision. Current manifest fetch adds ~200-400ms.

sara_m: Important: include authz outcome. If runtime attempts rebind and IAM denies it, we need a deterministic fallback within SLO; current infinite retries spike p95.

jordan: Suggest handback_hint values: [local-kms, controlplane-kv, no-handback]. Fallback semantics: if hint==local-kms && mode==Private -> runtime rebinds. Else control-plane tries once with timeout 1000ms then degrade to safe-fail (serve degraded or 429).

maggie_h: Telemetry must be explicit: emit eviction_reason, handback_hint, rebind_outcome, rebind_latency_bucket, and trace_id. This will let us correlate token fetchs -> latency.

ops-bot: deploy: adapter:v2.14 applied eviction-handler refactor at 3998887785 :white_check_mark:

alex_tsai: Security: when runtime hands back anything to control-plane, it must not expose raw secrets. Use ephemeral references (JWT proof or short-ttl URI).

sara_m: Edge-case: Dedicated burst fallback that routes to a different model/region. Ensure tenancy isolation: never reuse creds across tenants; if unavailable, return explicit error rather than silently switching context.

jordan: Action items (I'll take): draft JSON schema for on_eviction, default timeouts/fallback rules, and telemetry spec.

maggie_h: I'll own security review of handback token exchange.

alex_tsai: Can we land a short RFC + tiny shim in adapter this week so we can run a staging chaos test?

sara_m: +1. Add a chaos test that forces rebind rejection and measures p95 for hosted vs private.

jordan: Will post draft to #docs-rfcs EOD and ping this thread.

alex_tsai: Thanks team :thumbsup:
